mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS over 3 months signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <50% of instances when FEDFUNDS decline by >1% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A single month where FEDFUNDS cross above 2.0% triggers a sell-off in risk assets, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 2.0% in a month
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS cross above 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monetary easing (FEDFUNDS <1.5%) and deflationary pressure (CPIAUCSL <2.0%) create a dual signal for equity appreciation over 20 days.
failure_condition: Rank IC >0.03 over any 3-year rolling window when both proxies meet the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS over 3 months amplifies equity valuations, predicting positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS decline does not correlate with SPX returns (p>0.05) in late-cycle expansions.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDPC1 (demand) over 3 months signals robust economic activity, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive short-term S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: GDPC1 rise does not predict positive 5-day SPX returns in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When GDPC1 crosses above 14,000 in a month, it signals a surge in economic output, leading to prolonged equity appreciation over 60 days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 crosses above 14,000 in a month
failure_condition: SPX returns remain non-positive over 60 days despite GDPC1 crossing 14,000.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in UNRATE below 4.0% over 3 months reflects improving labor market conditions, fostering investor confidence and positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE below 4% does not predict positive returns in >70% of 20-day windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in UNRATE below 4.0% and PAYEMS below 130,000 indicate strengthening labor market and reduced unemployment, driving short-term equity gains over 5 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4.0% and PAYEMS falls below 130,000 in a month
failure_condition: Interaction of UNRATE and PAYEMS does not predict positive 5-day SPX returns (p>0.05).
